notes:
v4.6.100 — Custom Alpaca bots no longer try to use the IBKR gateway

🔀 BROKER ROUTING (custom bots)
• When you launched a CUSTOM bot (e.g. energy) the app forgot to tell the server which broker you were in, so the server fell back to your default broker — which made a custom bot started in Alpaca mode run on IBKR and uselessly boot the IB gateway (then fail 'gateway not ready'). Custom bots now send the active broker exactly like the built-in bots, so an Alpaca custom bot runs on Alpaca and never touches the IB gateway.

(Server-side, already applied: resolved an IBKR gateway login conflict so your IBKR bots connect cleanly again.)

Update via the in-app banner.
